ctx.x: Would it be 1900 or would it be 1910 or 1920 or what?

No, I don't think it was that far back. That's it. Dewey used to wait on Basin Street, Emmanuel Perez. That's when I was very small. Yeah, that must bring back. Let's see, wait, I got to get that thing straight. I think Tom could tell you better than I could about that. Tom Alba? Yeah. Because I had learned how to play cornet, you know, and Tom was playing the violin. And Eddie Vincent was practicing every day with us. And then all at once he picked up and he left there with Jimmy Fallon and then we went north.…
